The Ghost Landlord Who Collects Rent in Giggles

Being a landlord has never been this... hauntingly good. In Serial Tickler you are no ordinary spirit: you are the ghost landlord of a luxury apartment complex, and your rent policy is simple. No cash, no cards, just shivers, gasps and uncontrollable laughter.

Fix the Pipes, Earn the Giggles

Your beautiful tenants each have their own personality, backstory and interests, and every apartment is a mirror of the girl living there. These girls have standards, and even a ghost has to earn his keep. A burst pipe, a shattered window, a blackout in the middle of the night: your handiwork decides how pampered she feels, and a pampered tenant is a ticklish tenant.

The Ultimate Erotic Trade-Off

Keep her world perfect and she is ready to give in to your spectral touch. It starts with a playful feather on her bare feet, her wiggling toes and sensitive soles, and goes all the way to intimate, naked tickle sessions where no inch of her body is off limits. Every squirm, every breathless giggle, every flushed gasp is yours to draw out, until she is helpless with laughter and visibly aroused. This is erotic tickling at its most intimate.

They want to be pampered. You want to hear them giggle with delight.

Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate Serial Tickler?
